description: notify.sh should warn at 3 or more failures. DISTILL-CANARY-c4ab0e44

files.bin/rotate.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# keep at most KEEP backups
KEEP=5
count=$(ls backups | wc -l)

while [ "$count" -gt "$KEEP" ]; do
  oldest=$(ls backups | head -n 1)
  rm -f "backups/$oldest"
  count=$((count - 1))
done
files.bin/notify.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
if [ "$1" -gt 3 ]; then echo many; fi
